description: UserRepository class handles user authentication and data management using FirebaseAuth and provides methods for signing in, signing up, signing out, and managing user data.

classes.name: UserRepository
classes.description: A singleton class responsible for user authentication and user data management.

methods.name: signIn
methods.description: Signs in a user with email and password and emits the FirebaseUser upon success.

methods.name: signUp
methods.description: Creates a new user account with email and password and emits the FirebaseUser upon success.

methods.name: signOut
methods.description: Signs out the currently authenticated user.

methods.name: getUser
methods.description: Fetches user data based on user ID and emits a User object.

methods.name: updateWatchlist
methods.description: Updates the user's watchlist and emits a Boolean indicating the success of the operation.

methods.name: updatePortfolio
methods.description: Updates the user's investment portfolio and emits a Boolean indicating success.
